mechanism: Liraglutide delays gastric emptying and may reduce primaquine absorption; primaquine carries hemolytic risk in G6PD-deficient patients which may be exacerbated by metabolic stress from liraglutide's glucoregulatory effects.
action: Monitor for adequate primaquine efficacy and G6PD status; consider alternative antimalarial if possible or ensure G6PD testing is performed prior to primaquine use.
